action.question: Which kinds of "search" do you want allowed without prompts?

questions.question: Which kinds of "search" do you want allowed without prompts?

options.label: Code search tools (Grep, Glob)
options.description: Allow Claude's built-in code search tools (Grep for content, Glob for filename patterns) without prompting.

options.label: Web search (WebSearch, WebFetch)
options.description: Allow Claude to search the web and fetch URLs without prompting.

options.label: Shell search commands (grep, rg, find, ag)
options.description: Allow Bash invocations of grep/ripgrep/find/silversearcher without prompting.

options.label: File reading (Read)
options.description: Allow reading any file without prompting.

options.label: Global (all projects) (Recommended)
options.description: Add to ~/.claude/settings.json so it applies in every project.

options.label: This project only (team-shared)
options.description: Add to .claude/settings.json (checked into git, shared with the team).

transcript_tail.text: I want to make sure I add the right permissions. "Search anything" could mean several different things.

expected.rec_session: Code search tools (Grep, Glob), Web search (WebSearch, WebFetch), Shell search commands (grep, rg, find, ag), File reading (Read), Global (all projects) (Recommended)
